name: orchestrate
description: Manage edge devices and roll out applications with logiccloud orchestrate (formerly Fleet Manager): the orchestrate MCP server (OAuth login) and skills for the lco CLI.

domain.title: orchestrate domain
domain.description: Root domain of your orchestrate installation, without https:// (e.g. orchestrate.example.com). The MCP server is https://mcp.<domain>/mcp, the login https://keycloak.<domain>.
